preconditions.expression: isinstance(adj, list) and all(isinstance(neighbors, list) for neighbors in adj)
preconditions.description: The adjacency list `adj` is a list of lists, where each sublist contains the neighbors of a node.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= node < V for node in range(V))
preconditions.description: Each node is labelled with a distinct integer in the range 0 to V - 1.

preconditions.expression: not any(node in neighbors for node in range(V) for neighbors in adj)
preconditions.description: The graph won't contain self loops.

preconditions.expression: all(not neighbors for neighbors in adj if len(neighbors) == 0)
preconditions.description: Each node is a terminal node if there are no outgoing edges.

preconditions.expression: all(not any(True for neighbor in neighbors if neighbor not in terminal_nodes) for neighbors in adj)
preconditions.description: A node is a safe node if every possible path starting from that node leads to a terminal node.

postconditions.expression: isinstance(output, list) and all(isinstance(node, int) for node in output)
postconditions.description: The output is a list of integers.
The output list is sorted in ascending order.

postconditions.expression: all(node in adj[node] for node in output if len(adj[node]) > 0)
postconditions.description: Each node in the output is a safe node.

postconditions.expression: all(node in output for node in range(V) if not adj[node])
postconditions.description: Every terminal node is included in the output.
